summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

size.note: default is a 32x20px track; sm is 24x16px.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not focusable; not submitted.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, the full size of the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Circle that slides from the start edge (off) to the end edge (on); the position, not only the color, shows the state. Mirrors under rtl.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color and the thumb moves to the end edge.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute, or a disabled ancestor fieldset

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state, formDisabledCallback follows a disabled fieldset, disabled is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: The track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px), below 24x24 in height; the label beside it is part of the clickable row, and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). It does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; checked state is exposed as aria-checked by the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as it is flipped
A setting row needs its consequence explained
The setting must be on before the form is submitted
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is enabled

useCases.when: A dense row where the switch must be smaller

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded when the form is submitted, such as agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch promises an immediate on/off effect; a recorded choice reads as a checkbox
A switch has two states only

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch that triggers an action rather than holding a state
antiPatterns.why: Switches keep their state; an action has none

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("Enable" / "Disable")
antiPatterns.why: The state is announced already; a changing label makes it ambiguous
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

coverage: label is the name; label click toggles; role is switch
Space toggles; Enter submits and does not toggle; keyboard focus ring
checked paints differently and the thumb moves; sm size dimensions
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset, error customError, label for

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default border-input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted from the visual reference (look and sizes), WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern and the Checkbox contract as the form-associated sibling?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track.

openQuestions.question: How is the switch role exposed?
openQuestions.answer: A native <input type=checkbox> with role="switch": native focus, Space, validity and form behavior, with the switch role and on/off state announced.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, as in Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and how are they named?
openQuestions.answer: Two, default (32x20px) and sm (24x16px); the API aliases already map them to medium and small. The size tokens already exist in the semantic layer.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle or submit?
openQuestions.answer: Submit, as for every form control (SB-0009). The APG makes Enter optional on a switch; only Space toggles.

openQuestions.question: Does required mean the switch must be on?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, native required semantics (valueMissing while off), the same as a required checkbox. Offered for consent-like settings; unusual otherwise.

openQuestions.question: Is there an indeterminate or read-only state?
openQuestions.answer: No. A switch is strictly on or off; the vocabulary entries exist for other components.

openQuestions.question: What submits and what does a reset restore?
openQuestions.answer: value (default "on") only while on; nothing while off. Reset restores the checked attribute's state.
